parameters.content:
# Bid and Follow-Up Automation System
One workflow, five lanes. Every trigger on the left runs through the single **Config** node (edit your details there once) and the **Which lane?** switch sends it to the right lane.

The Google Sheet is the source of truth: **Bids** is the tracker, **Templates** holds the copy and cadence. Edit those in the sheet, not here.

Stop any customer's follow-ups by setting their status to anything other than Sent / Following Up.

## 1. Bid intake
A new bid from the website form hits this webhook (POST). It is normalized, given a bid_id, and logged in the **Bids** tab with status **Sent**. The scheduler picks it up from there.

Webhook URL: `https://YOUR-N8N/webhook/new-bid`

You can also add a row by hand in the sheet with status Sent and a date_sent. The scheduler handles it the same way.

## Optional: start from the form's notification email
If the form cannot call a webhook, enable this Gmail trigger and it will parse the notification email instead. Adjust the subject filter in the trigger and the field names in **Parse Notification Email** to match the form.

filters.q: subject:(new bid OR new estimate OR estimate request)

parameters.content:
## 2. Follow-up scheduler
Runs every hour, 9am to 5pm Central, Monday to Friday. For every bid with status **Sent** or **Following Up** it checks whether the next touch is due, sends it (email via Gmail, text via Twilio), and moves the bid forward.

The cadence lives in the **Templates** tab (day + channel + copy). Change days or wording there. Nothing here needs editing.

Stopping a bid: any reply, a STOP, or setting the status to Booked / Declined / anything other than Sent or Following Up.

## Why one touch per bid per run
If a bid was entered late and several touches are already overdue, it still gets at most one touch per hour and never two on the same day. The next touch is always at least the next business morning.

parameters.content:
## 3. Customer texts back
Twilio posts every inbound text here. Point the Twilio number's **Messaging > A message comes in** webhook at:
`https://YOUR-N8N/webhook/twilio-inbound` (HTTP POST)

The bid is matched by phone number, marked **Replied** (or **Opted Out** on STOP), all remaining touches stop, and the team is alerted by text and email.

Twilio also enforces STOP on its side, so the number is blocked even if this workflow is paused.

## 4. Customer emails back
Watches the sending inbox every minute. A new email is matched to a bid by Gmail thread first, then by the sender's address. Matches are marked **Replied**, remaining touches stop, and the team is alerted by text and email. Unrelated inbox mail is ignored.

## 5. Daily summary
Every morning at 8am Central: which bids are still in follow-up, what goes out today, and every reply from the last 24 hours. Sent to the team email in the Config node.
